images.subject: A metal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw ore out of the tunnel to a large foundry at the foot of the building, with tall chimneys and rows of glowing orange molten metal ingots.
images.detail: Thick veins of raw silver and copper metal run through the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal coated in fine grey rock dust, and illuminated light strips.

images.subject: A metal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw ore out of the tunnel. At the end of the conveyor, in the foreground, stands a large separate foundry building with glowing orange furnace mouths, two tall smoking chimneys and rows of glowing molten metal ingots cooling outside.
images.detail: Thick veins of raw silver and copper metal run through the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal coated in fine grey rock dust, and illuminated light strips.
